in_marathi.name: Aryadeep
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aryadeep हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Aryadeep is derived from Sanskrit words 'Arya' meaning noble, and 'Deep' meaning deep. This name is often associated with the celestial bodies, and is a name of the Sun God, Surya, in Hindu mythology.
